title: Brewing mod
description: A client-side Fabric mod for potion brewers. Includes brew timers with a HUD overlay, a keybind to load recipe ingredients straight to your hotbar, and a config screen to manage multiple recipes. Fabric 1.21.11, client-side only.
body:
AllUtils — Brewing Utilities
A client-side utility mod for Fabric 1.21.1 focused on potion brewing workflows.
Features
Brew Timers — Press a keybind to start a countdown timer shown in your HUD. Timers are color-coded by time remaining and can be linked to a cauldron position.
Recipe Hotbar Loader — Save ingredient recipes in the in-game config screen and press a keybind to instantly move the right items from your inventory to your hotbar.
Quickcraft — Automates crafting table output, repeatedly crafting until ingredients run out.
Replanter — Automatically replants crops on harvest.
Requirements

Fabric Loader
Fabric API
Client-side only — works on any server
